levels.description: Unlock Untouched Edge: once per combat, empower your next weapon hit by up to 60% based on damage taken this combat.

effects.name: Untouched Edge
effects.description: Once per combat, your next weapon attack gains up to 60% power. The bonus shrinks as cumulative damage taken in this combat approaches 50% of maximum HP.

levels.description: Gain Unscathed Presence: all damage +50% at zero damage taken, falling linearly to no bonus after taking damage equal to 50% maximum HP.

effects.name: Unscathed Presence
effects.description: All damage gains up to 50%, reduced by cumulative damage taken this combat; zero bonus after taking 50% maximum HP damage.
